derivation.summary: The earlier clock-order/numeral-overlay derivation is an unverified historical hypothesis, not a native-image-established selector. The byte-exact raster audit found no twelve-clock-numeral layer; a candidate family can only be generated after author-grounded geometry maps to exactly twelve BIP39 wordlist cells. The certified oracle remains ready to derive BIP44 addresses and compare them to the winner wallet once such a family exists.
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39 all-zero-entropy test vector and the artist's own prior solved 'Bifurcations' BIP84 vector

difficulty_note: The previously assumed numeral-overlays-word selector cannot be derived from the byte-exact native raster: its visible red labels are plot-axis/scale labels rather than a twelve-hour numeral set. The audited bottom-pixel and ray-length variants therefore have N=0. The unresolved prerequisite is an author-grounded mapping from artwork geometry to exactly twelve BIP39 wordlist cells; without it, no further candidate family is bounded.

leads.title: recover an author-grounded twelve-cell geometry mapping
resample at the numeral's bottom pixel instead of its centroid
test the sunburst ray length as an alternative per-hour selector
